recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man with a mustache and feathered hair, seated cross-legged against a neutral studio wall. The image is contained within a thin black border, surrounded by a wide white margin that hosts the typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within an internal frame
Large-scale script overlapping the top frame edge
Wide-tracked sans-serif text anchored at the bottom edge
Soft, directional lighting creating a gentle gradient on the background
coreInvariants: Subject's gaze directed away from the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally positioned, occupying approximately 70% of the internal frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark vest and hair provide a central weight, while the top script acts as the primary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large script at the top, moves down to the subject's face, follows the line of his arms to his hands, and finally rests on the wide-tracked text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space in the white outer margins and the upper-right quadrant of the internal frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and neutral grey background tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and black in the clothing and frame lines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and tan floor surface.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on tonal gradients and soft shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Monolinear cursive script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Continuous monolinear stroke, low slant, wide loops, overlapping the frame.
Bottom text: All-caps, high-waisted, extremely wide tracking with dots between words.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'J' and 'P' have large, open loops that extend beyond the frame boundary.
The bottom text uses interpuncts (centered dots) as word separators.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, organic script and rigid, geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, handwritten feel of the top text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura or ITC Avant Garde Gothic
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric, clean look for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a man with 1980s hair and mustache, wearing a pinstripe vest over a light shirt and jeans, sitting cross-legged. Place this inside a thin black rectangular frame with a wide white border around the entire composition.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, monolinear cursive name across the top, overlapping the frame. Add a single line of all-caps, wide-tracked sans-serif text at the very bottom of the white margin, using dots between words.

verificationChecks: Does the script overlap the top frame line?
Is the bottom text extremely wide-tracked with dots?
Is there a clear white margin around the central framed image?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script is legible despite the overlap.
Check that the interpuncts are vertically centered.
Verify the white margin is consistent on all four sides.
Confirm the subject is looking away from the camera.
recipe.reuseFormula: Place a soft-lit portrait in a thin-bordered box; surround with a wide white margin; top with a large monoline script; bottom with wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.
